description: Read driver-app events for the live routes — on_duty, off_duty, start_route, end_route, start_service, success, failed, rejected, start_time_changed — up to 500 per call. Pass the returned tag as after_tag next time to get only newer events; remainingEvents says whether more are waiting. Events can arrive out of order when devices were offline. OptimoRoute: GET /get_events.

after_tag.description: The tag from a previous call; omit to read from the start.

name: optimoroute_get_events
title: Get mobile events
